Title: COO, Demiurge Studios
Talk Track: I spent five years owning identity and cloud operations for Pokemon's consumer platforms, then built the shared technical-operations org covering four studios at Prytania Media. Your IT Manager posting asks one person to keep systems running and documentation current while also "migrating our systems to co-location and cloud, as well as modernization of our identity stack" - reporting to the COO. Those are two jobs on two different clocks. Support always wins the day, so the migrations quietly slip a quarter or two and nobody can name the week it happened. The part worth having before you hire: identity is what your partner security obligations actually rest on, so it is the piece to sequence first and own separately from the help-desk load. Is the co-lo date already committed to a partner?
